title: Dandimastak Churna
description: Dandimastak Churna (Dadimashtaka Churna) is a sweet-and-sour classical formulation using Pomegranate rind (Dadima) along with digestive herbs. This formulation is highly successful in controlling loose motions through astringent action that reduces intestinal secretions. Heavy mucus in stools (indicating poor digestion and absorption) is reduced. Malabsorption syndrome (Grahani) where the intestines fail to properly absorb nutrients is addressed through tissue repair and improved digestive function. Flatulence is reduced through improved digestion.
dosage: Mixed with lukewarm water or thin buttermilk
